description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for an event-driven programming library used in Redis. It includes event loop management, file and time event handling, and callback function types.

methods.name: aeCreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new event loop with a specified size.

methods.name: aeCreateFileEvent
methods.description: Registers a file descriptor for readable/writable events.

methods.name: aeDeleteFileEvent
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the event loop.

methods.name: aeGetFileEvents
methods.description: Retrieves registered events for a file descriptor.

methods.name: aeCreateTimeEvent
methods.description: Creates a timed event that triggers after a specified delay.

methods.name: aeDeleteTimeEvent
methods.description: Deletes a timed event by its ID.

methods.name: aeProcessEvents
methods.description: Processes pending events based on flags.

methods.name: aeWait
methods.description: Waits for a file descriptor to become ready.

methods.name: aeGetApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the polling API used.

methods.name: aeSetBeforeSleepProc
methods.description: Sets a callback to run before the event loop sleeps.

methods.name: aeGetSetSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of file descriptors.

methods.name: aeResizeSetSize
methods.description: Resizes the set of tracked file descriptors.
